t.zh: 行滤波器让左权重乘左邻、右权重乘右邻，权重和位置一一对应。课上的卷积却规定：先把卷积核左右翻转，再滑过去求加权和。
t.en: The row filter multiplies the left weight by the left neighbour and the right by the right: weights match positions. Convolution as the lecture defines it first flips the kernel left to right, then slides it and sums.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：翻不翻转，结果差在哪？用一行只有一个亮点的图（脉冲）来看：先手算不翻转的结果，再用行滤波器接出真正的卷积。
t.en: This level asks: what does flipping change? Look at a row with a single bright cell (an impulse): work out the unflipped result by hand, then wire true convolution from the row filter.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>：不翻转是互相关，脉冲出来是倒过来的核；卷积先翻转，出来就是核本身。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>: without the flip it is correlation, and an impulse comes out as the kernel reversed; convolution flips first, and an impulse comes out as the kernel itself.

brief.zh: 不翻转，权重左 1、中 2、右 3 滑过这一行脉冲，图外补 0：写出结果。
brief.en: Without flipping, slide the weights left 1, centre 2, right 3 over this impulse, 0 outside: write the result.

hint.zh: 亮点左边那一格，算加权和时亮点是它的哪个邻居？
hint.en: For the cell left of the bright one, which neighbour is the bright cell?

why.zh: 以为脉冲出来的就是核 [1, 2, 3]：亮点在左边那一格的右邻，乘的是右权重 3。不翻转时，出来的是倒过来的 [3, 2, 1]。
why.en: Expecting the kernel [1, 2, 3] back: for the cell to its left, the bright cell is the right neighbour and meets the right weight 3. Without the flip, out comes [3, 2, 1] reversed.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和卷积核 k1、k2、k3（按书写顺序）：交出卷积的结果，图外补 0。
brief.en: Given an image and the kernel k1, k2, k3 (in written order), give the convolution, 0 outside.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="rowFilter"></part-ref> 不翻转；翻转之后，k1 落到哪一边？
hint.en: The <part-ref to="rowFilter"></part-ref> does not flip; flipped, which side does k1 land on?
